targets.coverage: Paper 20, Ein algebraisches Kriterium fuer absolute Irreduzibilitaet, source printed pp.26-33. The package includes the source PDF, one 650dpi witness crop, audit notes, fix-request/disposition CSV, checksums, and a patched cumulative German TeX copy under applied_fixed_tex for the formula (13) kappa/lambda correction.
targets.findings: One source-confirmed correction: formula (13) factor-sum indices should be kappa and lambda rather than mu and nu. The following prose products varrho_mu sigma_nu remain unchanged. The audit also records that Paper 20 uses ordinary numbered footnotes, so the Paper 06-Paper 08 symbolic-footnote apparatus pattern should not be applied here.
targets.limitations: This is a local applied-fix/provenance companion and not a whole-paper or whole-corpus certification. The later Noether_P20_RA49_SourceCritical_Fix_WebDrop_20260614.zip is the preferred German candidate branch for promotion/reconciliation.
targets.next_action: Upload as provenance only if keeping the full P20 Lean audit chain is useful; otherwise RA49 can carry the applied correction in the next Noether source-audit upload. In either case, do not treat this as complete Paper 20 source closure or a critical edition.
